amendments.after: 店の駐車場に戻ったら、ドアに新しい傷がありました。どう説明すればよいですか。
amendments.reason: The metadata describes finding a scratch while parked; turn4 keeps the car in the shop parking lot, turn6 takes the photo before entering, and turn10 awaits staff before moving it. Returning TO the parking lot (に) resolves the erroneous FROM particle (から). All twelve translations already reflect return to the car/parking area.
